description: This 3D model depicts a minimalist and conceptual architectural structure. It features a prominent golden, multi-tiered staircase-like element, both below and on top of a central white, irregularly shaped platform that resembles a bridge or walkway. Above the platform, there's a smaller, golden cage-like structure that also contains golden steps. The entire central arrangement is framed by two tall, grey, U-shaped walls behind it, creating a sense of enclosure or a gateway. The structure is set on a large, flat grey base, simulating ground. The design evokes a modern, abstract art piece or a functional, yet symbolic, architectural pathway.
